## Overview

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## MCQ EXAM: Wednesday 11 March

**Date**: Wednesday 11 March 2026  
**Time**: Check your timetable  
**Location**: Check your exam allocation  
**Duration**: 1 hour  

This is a summative assessment worth **20%** of your module grade. **There is no lecture this week** — the Wednesday session is the exam.
:::

**Thursday lab**: **Project Toolkit — Phase 2**. Finalise stimulus materials, complete the Researcher Procedure, add Recruitment Script and Data Recording Sheet, **practice running the study** on each other, and complete the Research Study Order Form. By the end of this lab you should be ready for data collection (Week 20). **There is no Week 19 lab** (testing); Week 20 is lecture + data collection lab.

**Wednesday**: MCQ Exam (no lecture)  
**Lab**: Thursday 10:00-12:00 WB304A / WB304B

## Exam Information

### What to Expect

::: {.callout-note}
## Exam format
- **Number of questions**: 36 multiple-choice questions (5 investigations + 6 general)
- **Time allowed**: Check exam instructions
- **Topics**: All content from Weeks 11–17 (designs, IV/DV, hypotheses, test choice, p-values, correlation, operationalisation, replication, confounding, null hypothesis, population)
- **Format**: Paper-based exam
:::

### Exam Tips

::: {.callout-tip}
## Last-minute advice
1. **Read each question carefully** — look for key words like "NOT", "EXCEPT", "ALWAYS"
2. **Eliminate obviously wrong answers** — narrow down your choices
3. **Manage your time** — don't spend too long on any single question
4. **Answer every question** — no penalty for guessing
:::

## Project Toolkit — Phase 2 (Thursday Lab)

Phase 2 completes the toolkit so you are ready for **data collection in Week 20**.

Your group will:

1. **Recruitment Script** — Short script for approaching participants (template in toolkit)
2. **Data Recording Sheet** — Table for participant number, condition, DV score, scoring guide (draft in Week 18, finalise by Week 19)
3. **Stimulus materials** — Finalise word lists, images, questionnaires, etc. (toolkit has templates and examples)
4. **Researcher Procedure** — **Complete** the procedure you started in Week 17 (data recording, scoring, full script)
5. **Practice run** — Run the study on each other; fix any problems with timing, instructions, or materials
6. **Research Study Order Form** — List everything you need printed or provided for data collection day; submit by **end of Week 19** at latest

::: {.callout-tip}
